dct_description_sm: The Richmond Bay Watershed Estuary Monitoring project works to create and implement estuary sampling techniques within Mill Creek estuary. The goal of this project is to create a baseline water quality database via long-term monitoring of the selected estuarine habitat. Data on physio-chemical parameters is collected using a YSI probe at all sampling locations. In the future, the collected data will be used to determine trends in the overall water quality status for the Mill Creek estuary.
